nodes.label: AMPM Platform - Decision Log
nodes.rationale: Record of AMPM's 25 October decisions plus the round-two decisions of 26 October, generated from decisions.json; 16 questions decided, 7 partly decided, 2 still open.

nodes.label: Q1 - Delivery platform
nodes.rationale: Native iOS and Android apps with offline wedding-day access, sync and conflict resolution; 26 Oct 2026 added browser client portals and tablet support for both apps.

nodes.label: Q2 - Payment mode for Phase 1
nodes.rationale: AMPM creates or invites the account, the client enters basic wedding details and pays the subscription online by card or UPI; 26 Oct 2026 the gateway is Razorpay.

nodes.label: Q3 - Subscription shape
nodes.rationale: Hotel-discovery subscription of Rs 50,000, one-time, one month, configurable; the demo serves as the trial; 26 Oct 2026 the demo has no time limit, three locations, one real hotel each, and no refund.

nodes.label: Q4 - Client-visible finance
nodes.rationale: Hotel discovery is a separate paid service; internal cost and margin never shown; online milestone payments out of the first release; which client-facing amounts and which chargeable hotel services remain open.

nodes.label: Q5 - Client-side users
nodes.rationale: Two nominated family representatives, one per side, with equal rights; 26 Oct 2026 working decision two authenticated accounts; whether one approval or both completes a decision remains open.

nodes.label: Q6 - Roles
nodes.rationale: AMPM controls permissions with department-based staff access; the final role list and who may see hotel and vendor costs remain to be confirmed.

nodes.label: Q7 - Guest identity in the RSVP portal
nodes.rationale: Links per side or one combined link; the RSVP team manages the list; guests cannot edit after submission; the final link structure remains open.

nodes.label: Q8 - Identity documents
nodes.rationale: Collected only where a hotel requires, never Aadhaar, in restricted storage; no automatic deletion; retention period and privacy wording remain to be confirmed.

nodes.label: Q9 - Hotel data
nodes.rationale: Eva maintains about 200 hotels with indicative prices, menus and street view, updated about three times a year; availability checked on request; hotels importable from spreadsheets.

nodes.label: Q10 - Phase 1 scope
nodes.rationale: First release spans discovery, wedding management, vendors, client portal, department access, RSVP, requests, live chat and offline operations; excludes website editing, online milestone payments and GST; 26 Oct 2026 one go-live.

nodes.label: Q11 - Guest and client communication channels
nodes.rationale: Email and WhatsApp required, SMS proposed, live chat on the home page; WhatsApp and SMS providers remain to be confirmed.

nodes.label: Q12 - Public website
nodes.rationale: No in-app public website editor in the initial scope; the website is maintained outside the platform.

nodes.label: Q13 - Sign-in
nodes.rationale: Clients sign in by mobile OTP, verified by email and mobile; no self-registration; 26 Oct 2026 staff use a password plus an authenticator-app code and the identity service is Amazon Cognito in Mumbai.

nodes.label: Q14 - Hosting and data residency
nodes.rationale: 26 Oct 2026 everything on AMPM's dedicated Hostinger KVM 4 VPS in Mumbai, pgBackRest to a Mumbai S3 bucket with rehearsed restores, files and identity documents in Mumbai buckets; all personal data stays in India.

nodes.label: Q15 - Volumes
nodes.rationale: About 200 hotels and 20 concurrent weddings as a planning assumption; staff count and largest guest count remain to be confirmed.

nodes.label: Q16 - Currency, language and tax
nodes.rationale: Indian rupees, English as the primary language; the platform issues no GST invoices.

nodes.label: Q17 - Privacy notice, consent wording and retention schedule
nodes.rationale: Still open: AMPM decides the final privacy wording and retention policy; no automatic deletion and deletion requires AMPM approval; periods for leads, guest records and identity documents to be confirmed.

nodes.label: Q18 - Multi-hotel weddings and venues outside the database
nodes.rationale: A wedding can involve multiple hotels and venues.

nodes.label: Q19 - Room blocks and rooming rules
nodes.rationale: Room blocks by hotel, category and dates; team-managed allocation; room-wise and person-wise counts, children included.

nodes.label: Q20 - In-portal messaging or questions
nodes.rationale: Both tracked requests with conversation history and home-page live chat required, kept distinct so a formal change request keeps its own approval history.

nodes.label: Q21 - Change-request workflow and statuses
nodes.rationale: Change requests flow submitted, reviewed, accepted or rejected, implemented and closed; a change to an approved item creates a new version for approval.

nodes.label: Q22 - Vendor or hotel logins, now or later
nodes.rationale: No vendor or hotel logins in the current version.

nodes.label: Q23 - Client portal access after the wedding
nodes.rationale: Read-only client access for three months, then archiving on AMPM approval; records not deleted, archiving is a status and permission change; the archiving and reopening workflow remains open.

nodes.label: Q24 - Post-wedding feedback and archive expectations
nodes.rationale: A short post-wedding feedback form and an archived state that preserves the records.

nodes.label: Q25 - Definition of a material change and the resulting flags
nodes.rationale: Still open: thresholds must be configurable; AMPM will define the final budget-change percentages, date-change and venue-change thresholds and the approval rules.

nodes.label: Items AMPM listed to confirm before development
nodes.rationale: The eleven items from the brief; items 1-4 answered 26 October 2026 (demo, sample hotels, Razorpay, two accounts), the rest (roles/costs, hosting, capacity, providers, privacy, thresholds, archiving) still pending.

nodes.label: Requirements AMPM added beyond the questions
nodes.rationale: Extra requirements beyond the 25 questions: demo and activation detail, hotel page content, selection/cart availability triggers, vendor categories, tracked-request statuses, offline staff scope, readiness exceptions, configurable settings, public website scope, tablet support and email+mobile verification.
